records.title: Upgradation of NH-719
details: a : Government has awarded Consultancy services work for preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) for development of Gwalior-Bhind- MP/UP border section of NH-719 to 4/6 lanes in the state of Madhya Pradesh.

records.title: Incentives for participation under Pradhan Mantri Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojna
details: I do not have detailed information right now that how many people have been trained in the Hon'ble Member's constitutency. I will provide this information in writing to the Hon'ble Member.

records.title: National Highway Projects in Bihar and West Bengal
details: You have mentioned that Gwalior-Bhind-Etawah motor road, which is NH719. Some part of it already has four lanes, whose DPR is in progress. On the basis of study traffic, I would like to bring to your notice that for this the DPR process is under progress and after completion of DPR process further action will be taken on it. As this is 108 km road and DPR has already been awarded for this.
